name: How long does a kitchen remodel usually take from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: How long does a kitchen remodel usually take from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a kitchen remodel depends on its complexity and scale. A minor remodel, involving mainly cosmetic changes, might take 3-5 weeks. A mid-range remodel, including cabinet replacement, new countertops, and appliance installation, typically ranges from 6-10 weeks. Extensive remodels that involve reconfiguring the layout, moving plumbing or electrical lines, or structural changes can take 10-16 weeks or even longer. This timeline includes planning, material ordering, demolition, and installation. Unexpected issues or material delays can also extend the project timeframe.
acceptedAnswer.description: A kitchen remodel typically takes 3-16 weeks, varying by complexity. Minor remodels are quicker, while extensive projects with structural changes take longer.
